issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): 3 unused public tool symbols from sase-1cx.3 (HandoffSubmitResult, StarterResolution, owner_ref)

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Deterministic: `just symvision` (and the lint (symvision) stage of `sase tool run check`, run 10ad13d1995cb9191a95794c3ae6a615) reports these every run on master 7885562f54 plus the sase-1d5 landing's symvision fix:

- `HandoffSubmitResult` in `src/sase/tool/handoff_launch.py`
- `StarterResolution` in `src/sase/tool/starter.py`
- `owner_ref` in `src/sase/tool/owner.py`

All three came from 018061f6f2 (feat(tool): starter scoped tool runs with detach and handoff, sase-1cx.3). They were hidden until now: symvision stops at its first error category, and the sase-1d5 private-import error (`_scanner_rules_version`, `_store_growth_lines`) masked the unused-public stage. That is why the sase-1cx landing recorded "the 7 symvision symbols are clean". The sase-1d5 landing fixes that private-import error, which unmasks these.

Root cause: no non-test file imports these names (a `grep -rlw` over src finds only each defining file). Fix per the symvision decision hierarchy: privatize if they are used only in their own file, delete if dead, and add a pragma only for a real consumer symvision can't see. sase-1cx is closed, so no --epic-symbol re-key applies.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1d5 land agent unmasked these by fixing an earlier symvision error; their epic sase-1cx is already closed, so no active epic can absorb them.
